## Import libraries

```{r}
#| include: false

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(3345678)
```

## Human retinal organoid

### Load data

Datasets: GSE268630

```{r}
#| include: false

# S1
dataset <- paste0(getwd(), "/dataset/GSE142526/")
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = dataset)
seu_obj_hsro_1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "Human retinal organoid", min.cells = 3)
seu_obj_hsro_1$age <- "D60"
seu_obj_hsro_1$species <- "Human"

# S2
dataset <- paste0(getwd(), "/dataset/GSE136929/")
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = dataset)
seu_obj_hsro_2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "Human retinal organoid", min.cells = 3)
seu_obj_hsro_2$age <- "D90"
seu_obj_hsro_2$species <- "Human"
```

### QC and filtration

```{r}
#| echo: false

seu_obj_hsro_1[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_hsro_1, pattern = "^MT-")
seu_obj_hsro_1_filtered <- subset(seu_obj_hsro_1, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & percent.mt < 10)
seu_obj_hsro_2[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_hsro_2, pattern = "^MT-")
seu_obj_hsro_2_filtered <- subset(seu_obj_hsro_2, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & percent.mt < 10)
```

### Preprocessing

```{r}
#| include: false

seu_obj_hsro_list <- list(seu_obj_hsro_1_filtered, seu_obj_hsro_2_filtered)
seu_obj_hsro_list <- lapply(seu_obj_hsro_list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x) %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA() %>% FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.2)
  return(x)
})
```

### Doublets removal

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(DoubletFinder)

# Doulets should use a list to analyze

# 10X multiplet rate estimation table
get_10x_multiplet_rate <- function(cells_recovered) {
  cells <- c(500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000)
  rate  <- c(0.004, 0.008, 0.016, 0.023, 0.031, 0.039, 0.046, 0.054, 0.061, 0.069, 0.076)
  
  if (cells_recovered <= max(cells)) {
    rate <- approx(
      x = cells,
      y = rate,
      xout = cells_recovered,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  } else {
    rate <- (cells_recovered / 1000) * 0.008
  }
  return(rate)
}

est_rate <- sapply(seu_obj_hsro_list, function(x) {
  cells_recovered <- ncol(x)
  return(get_10x_multiplet_rate(cells_recovered))
})

# pK Identification (no ground-truth)
seu_obj_hsro_list <- lapply(seq_along(seu_obj_hsro_list), function(i) {
  
  set.seed(42)
  
  x <- seu_obj_hsro_list[[i]]
  sweep_list <- paramSweep(x, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
  sweep_stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep_list, GT = FALSE)
  bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep_stats)
  pK <- bcmvn %>% filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>% select(pK)
  pK <- as.numeric(as.character(pK[[1]]))
  
  # Homotypic doublet proportion estimate
  annotations <- x@meta.data$seurat_clusters
  homotypic_prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
  nExp_poi <- round(est_rate[i] * nrow(x@meta.data))
  nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  
  # Run DoubletFinder
  x <- doubletFinder(
    x,
    PCs = 1:30,
    pN = 0.25,
    pK = pK,
    nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
    sct = FALSE
  )
  colnames(x@meta.data)[grepl("DF.classifications.*", colnames(x@meta.data))] <- "doublet_finder"
  # Number of singlets and doublets
  print(table(x@meta.data$doublet_finder))
  # Removing doublets
  x <- subset(x, subset = doublet_finder %in% "Singlet")
  return(x)
})
```

### Merge data and integration

```{r}
#| include: false
seu_obj_hsro <- merge(seu_obj_hsro_list[[1]], y = seu_obj_hsro_list[-1])

seu_obj_hsro <- NormalizeData(seu_obj_hsro) %>% FindVariableFeatures() %>% ScaleData() %>% RunPCA() %>% FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters") %>% RunUMAP(dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

seu_obj_hsro <- IntegrateLayers(object = seu_obj_hsro, method = CCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE)

seu_obj_hsro <- FindNeighbors(seu_obj_hsro, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30) %>% FindClusters(resolution = 0.2, cluster.name = "cca_clusters") %>% RunUMAP(reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.cca")

seu_obj_hsro <- JoinLayers(seu_obj_hsro)
```

```{r}
#| include: false

saveRDS(seu_obj_hsro, file = "processed_dataset/HsRO_filtered_integrated.rds")
```
